scope: Reconcile the existing Git history, mounted recovery files and verified evidence before further science. Preserve meaningful uncommitted work and produce one current handoff.
owner_authority: The current owner explicitly requests git commit/push and reunion after accidentally branching the conversation. Prior author self-review permission remains; no independent-review claim is implied.
initial_decision: Do not restore an older conversation HEAD over the newer remote. Current remote handoff already records bounded Facet language and subsequence proofs absent from stale chat summaries.
safety: No force push or rewrite of frozen scientific commits.
No new native run, refit, protected cohort, production change or P9 admission during reconciliation.
Use readback of committed bytes, not successful-write responses, to certify preservation.
Inspect current remote before each write; stop and reconcile any unexpected concurrent advancement.
